questions.stem_text: A person is most likely to be helped in an emergency situation when:

options.A: there is no one else around.
options.C: there are several bystanders, all of whom are busy with their own tasks.
options.D: there are several bystanders of the same gender.
options.E: there are several bystanders of the opposite gender.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - there is no one else around.
